learningObjectives: Explain the structure and characteristics of MongoDB documents and collections.
Design document models for common application requirements.
Choose appropriate embedding and referencing strategies.

activities.instruction: Explore databases, collections, documents, and fields.

content.concept: MongoDB stores flexible JSON-like documents inside collections within databases.

activities.title: Embedding vs Referencing
activities.instruction: Select the suitable relationship strategy for each case.
